widgets_values: Select the SAME source, reference, seed and mask as your good native result. No Ollama and no face/body prompt wrapper. Queue once; use /_swap/chain. This still uses the disk controller, not the native in-memory loop. After reviewing the first 10 seconds start a NEW run for 48 seconds. Recovered workflows and the final MP4 keep the recorded settings.
